title: Apple AirPods 4 (ANC) Review: Premium Sound and Seamless Integration
subtitle: A comprehensive review of Apple’s latest wireless earbuds, highlighting design, performance, and value on Amazon.
author: Jakub Netza
content:
Apple’s AirPods 4 bring the next generation of true‑wireless earbuds to the market, combining active noise cancellation, adaptive transparency, spatial audio, and the new H2 chip for improved sound quality and battery life. In this review we’ll explore design, performance, battery life, and value, helping you decide if they’re worth the purchase on Amazon.

Design & Build Quality

The AirPods 4 retain the iconic stem design but now feature a more compact case with USB‑C charging and a matte finish. The earbuds are lightweight, sweat‑resistant (IPX4), and pair instantly with Apple devices via the H2 chip.

Sound Quality & Features

Spatial Audio with dynamic head tracking delivers immersive sound. ANC and Adaptive Transparency work seamlessly, and the H2 chip ensures low‑latency audio for gaming and calls.

Battery Life & Charging

Up to 6 hours of listening with ANC on a single charge, extending to 30 hours with the case. The case supports wireless charging and USB‑C fast charging, where 5 minutes gives roughly 1 hour of playback.

Comparison to AirPods 3

Compared to the previous generation, the AirPods 4 add ANC, improved battery, and USB‑C, making them a clear upgrade for most users.

Price & Availability

Amazon lists the AirPods 4 at $119 as of April 2026 with free shipping for Prime members. Buy on Amazon

Verdict

For Apple ecosystem users seeking ANC and the convenience of USB‑C, the AirPods 4 are a strong choice. Their price is competitive, and the feature set justifies the upgrade over AirPods 3.
